# Time Domain Math

![Time Domain Math function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/calculus/06-time_domain_math.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Computes derivative, difference, integral or summation on an existing timed waveform or an array of waveforms. Continuous and per-segment modes keep distinct node/invocation/channel state and preserve timestamps. Real DBL only; exact structured schemas and explicit real numeric promotion. Variants: waveform_derivative_continuous, waveform_derivative_segment, waveform_difference_continuous, waveform_difference_segment, waveform_integral_continuous, waveform_integral_segment, waveform_sum_continuous, waveform_sum_segment, waveforms_derivative_continuous, waveforms_derivative_segment, waveforms_difference_continuous, waveforms_difference_segment, waveforms_integral_continuous, waveforms_integral_segment, waveforms_sum_continuous, waveforms_sum_segment.
